compliance.emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A

features.clock-specs: G.8271.1, G.8272 PRTC, G.8273.2 T-BC/T-TSC, G.8273.4 APTS (via firmware upgrade), G.8262 EEC, G.8262.1 eEEC, G.8264 ESMC
features.optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR, 25G SFP28 CR DAC, 10G SFP+ SR/LR, SFP+ Twinax (datasheet supported-accessories list)
features.oran-sync: O-RAN LLS C1, C2, C3 synchronization topologies
features.timing-cables: SMA coax with 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS; SMB coax with 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz
features.timing-roles: IEEE 1588v2 T-GM, T-BC/OC (G.8275.1 telecom profile); SyncE with ESMC; PTP offload and redundancy; Assisted FTS

management.interfaces: managed from the host DU server - ufiCardMgmt CLI over the E-810 network interface to the card's management IP; UFI PTP Timing Software

thermal.cooling: host airflow, 500 LFM required (no onboard fans)

configs.description: N3100-4C 5G timing adapter, PCIe Gen4 x16 add-in card
configs.name: base

gaps.wanted: Identity of the SFP-cage-like connector standing on the card's rear edge near the left corner (visible in datasheet fig-0002 and HIG fig-0003 angled renders, ~15 mm wide silver shell with a black slot face). The interface list (GNSS SMA, 1PPS/10MHz SMB, 4x SFP28) does not include it and no document names it; not drawn until identified.

The function of the micro-USB receptacle on the left edge near the faceplate (datasheet fig-0002) - likely a console/debug port, but no document mentions it. Its position is also only estimated from an angled render; a straight-on side drawing or a caliper would settle both.

Storage temperature upper bound: the datasheet environmental table says -40 to 70 C, the installation guide's requirements list says -40 to 65 C - same measure, same scope, different value. The manifest carries the datasheet 70; a vendor errata or newer revision would settle it.

`attrs.platform.cpu`, `attrs.platform.memory`; one of `operating-temp`, `operating-temp-f2b`, `operating-temp-b2f` in `attrs.environmental` (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on port group sfp28 - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
the Nautobot exporter is not importable - unlocks NetBox / Nautobot device-type export

provenance.bottom-layout: estimated - the PCB underside, drawn as plain board; no source shows it. The gold edge-connector tab is outside the body footprint and does not appear on this face. Only symmetric content is drawn, so the left-right mirror convention could not be exposed by any feature - noted per the symmetric-face rule.
provenance.chassis: datasheet - 'Dimension (WxDxH) 126.35 x 181.07 x 21.95 mm', transcribed as width 126.35 / depth 181.07 / height 21.95 with the card lying flat as the vendor draws it (PCB horizontal, I/O plate at the front). The full-height PCIe bracket (right end) and the PCIe x16 gold edge connector (right side, in the PCB plane) both extend beyond these figures and are not modelled, per the body-between-the-ear-folds rule - they are how the card mounts, not what it is. Whether the vendor's 126.35 includes any bracket metal is unstated; the plate drawn in the HIG faceplate figure measures consistently with 126.35 excluding the bracket tab.
provenance.cutouts: registry - SMB openings at 4.83 (10-32UNF-2A), SMA at 6.35 (1/4-36UNS-2B), SFP apertures 14.5 x 10.0 (SFF-8432), all centred on the drawing-measured jack/cage centres above. LED holes 2.0 nominal at the measured lamp centres (drawn lens ~2.2 in the figure).
provenance.environment: datasheet - operating 0-55 C, 5-95 percent RH; storage humidity 5-93 percent. Storage temperature DISAGREES between the two documents: the datasheet says -40 to 70 C, the HIG installation requirements say -40 to 65 C - same measure, same scope, different value. The manifest carries the datasheet figure (the spec-table source); registered in gaps as sources-disagree.
provenance.front-layout: drawing - HIG fig-0005 (straight-on faceplate render, 1471x259 px). Gate 1: the plate face measures 1172 x 200 px against the datasheet 126.35 x 21.95 mm - aspect 5.86 vs 5.76, 1.8 percent - so fractions were taken per-axis at 9.276 px/mm (x, plate left edge at px 68) and 9.112 px/mm (y, top edge at px 7). SMB jack centres at x 18.65 / 31.37, y 11.0 (visually centred, plate centre 10.97); SMA centre (119.42, 9.77); SFP28 cage block px 426-1096 giving centres x 47.62 / 65.68 / 83.74 / 101.80 on an 18.06 mm pitch, cage vertical centre y 11.85; port LEDs (green, one per port, left of each number tag) centres x 43.99 / 61.88 / 79.67 / 97.46 at y 4.17. The photo confirms every count and the left-to-right order (1PPS, 10MHz, ports 0-3, GNSS ANT). The bracket retention screw head on the plate's left end reads 6.5 mm at centre (6.41, 7.46); drawn with common/screw-head at its 3.6 mm contract size, delta recorded here.
provenance.port-leds: drawing - one green lamp per SFP28 port, above the cage's left half beside the yellow port-number tag (HIG fig-0005; photo confirms). HIG 3.1: Off = no cable/no traffic, blinking green = 25G TX/RX, blinking amber = 10G or less TX/RX. The yellow number tags (5.9 x 2.85 mm, measured from the figure) are drawn as decor with the numeral as silkscreen ink on top.
provenance.power: datasheet - 'Max power Consumption: 48 Watts, Typical Power Consumption: 34 Watts' under the Power Supply row; the HIG repeats the 48 W maximum. Neither document states what configuration the figures assume (optics population), so power-envelope is unstated. Power is drawn from the host PCIe slot; there is no PSU.
provenance.rear-layout: estimated - no straight-on rear source. The rear is the enclosure's plain end with the PCB edge below it; drawn as the cover band over a PCB strip, sizes from the chassis contract. Angled renders (datasheet fig-0002, HIG fig-0003) show an unidentified SFP-cage-like connector standing on the rear edge near the left corner - no document names it, so it is NOT drawn; registered as a gap per the unidentified-feature precedent (gl-8xep right-side boss).
provenance.side-layout: estimated - both sides are the enclosure cover over the PCB edge; only the angled renders show them, so positions are estimates. LEFT side (x=0 = REAR per house convention) carries a micro-USB receptacle on the PCB near the front (datasheet fig-0002 bottom-left; centre estimated 13 mm behind the faceplate at PCB level) - the part is unmistakably a micro-USB, its function is stated nowhere (gap). RIGHT side (x=0 = FRONT) is the PCIe edge: the gold x16 edge connector extends beyond this face in the PCB plane and is not drawn; the face shows the cover over the PCB strip.
provenance.silkscreen: drawing - 1PPS, 10MHZ (spelled with a capital Z as printed) and GNSS ANT in dark ink below their jacks, port numerals 0-3 in black on the yellow tags; transcribed from fig-0005 and confirmed against the photo. The Sync LED is unlabelled on the hardware.
provenance.sources: vendor datasheet (working/intake/ufispace/converted/n3100-4c-datasheet - dimensions row, interfaces, power, environment, compliance), installation guide v1.1 17-Jul-2023 (n3100-4c-hig - faceplate render fig-0005 with the Sync LED callout, LED behaviour tables, PCIe slot requirements, installation CAD in fig-0004), vendor render photo (photos/n3100-4c-1-view.jpg, single angled card shot - counts and colour only), angled datasheet render (datasheet fig-0002 - left-edge micro-USB, rear-edge connector).
provenance.sync-led: drawing - the HIG fig-0005 callout leader points at a small dark rectangular lamp (px 289-310 x 168-178, ~2.3 x 1.1 mm) between the 1PPS and 10MHZ legends, centre (24.96, 18.22); the HIG names it the Sync LED. It carries NO printed legend on the plate - the name exists only in the guide. Drawn with common/led-dot (2.0 round), the closest library part; the rectangular 2.3 x 1.1 lens and the delta are recorded here. States from the HIG section 3.1 table.
provenance.top-layout: estimated - the top is the sheet-metal cover; angled renders show it plain with the green PCB margin visible along the right (PCIe) edge. Axis convention: y=0 is the REAR, per the house top-view precedent. Cover screw positions are not resolvable from the angled renders and are not drawn.
provenance.vents: drawing - square perforations around the SMB pair, ~2.5 mm squares on a 4.15 mm pitch: a six-square top row from x 12.72 (the row's right end is washed out by glare in the render; six is what both the render and the photo resolve), a three-square column at x 11.10 left of the 1PPS jack, and a two-square column at x 23.72 between the jacks. Sizes and pitch measured from fig-0005; the photo confirms the arrangement.
